title: Word-pair order survives fixed line inventories while simple full generators miss its joint envelope
statement: Across ZL, IT and RF in the public sample, 199 exact line permutations show excess repeated distinct directed edges and reduced mean degree, but the paper's self-adjacent word-type count is ordinary under the line null. Among the four full-layout mechanisms, none reproduces all three primary residuals. The off-diagonal conditional reordering matches RF on all three while requiring its observed line word bags. The conditional result does not carry to ZL or IT.
check: For a confirmatory comparison, freeze a full generative mechanism that independently matches within-line inventories and reproduces the three residuals across editions. Add only the necessary graph measurements to the existing scorer after review and compare an independently selected public or scorer-held sample with fixed masks and line boundaries.
protocol:
# K-047-open-1 local order and manuscript layout

Replicate the distinction from P-R-012 between the paper's distinct self-adjacent word types and repeated ordered edge types. Include loop-containing original graph measures and versions excluding loops. Follow the pinned public practice partition in ZL, IT and RF, fitting separate parameters on each edition's public training pages. Keep every original paragraph line width, masks and boundaries. Uncertain words are fixed barriers: they cannot move, are not vertices, and cannot join adjacent words across them. Line edges always terminate an adjacency run. Unlike the archival P-R-012 shared 615-line intersection, this uses the complete public practice paragraph inventory within each edition.

For the public reference use 199 exact whole-word permutations within lines, preserving each line and page's observed word multiset. Also use 99 within-page permutations for a broader comparison. The three central coordinates are distinct self-loop types/valid vertices, repeated directed edge types including loops/eligible boundaries, and mean out-degree including loops. Report the corresponding unequal-only edge and out-degree summaries separately. Residuals subtract the mean of the matching line null. Use upper/lower add-one tails, with the two-sided result twice their minimum capped at one; all stated tests are descriptive with edition and metric dependence. Compute exact null expected distinct loop types as an independent check.

For four conditional mechanisms start from the exact public evaluation bags of words and rearrange each bag one token at a time. An unavailable predecessor or a mask resets context. In the direct transition kernel eligible remaining tokens have weight multiplicity × (1 + C(u,v)/(4q(v)))^.5 from training paragraph edges and a smoothed training unigram q. The diagonal and off-diagonal ablations selectively replace other bonuses by one. The glyph-class alternative uses the same formula on a class defined by the first and last EVA-basic glyphs. Fresh word types without trained transitions receive neutral weights. These runs measure conditional ordering and use no observed test token order or graph score to fit a parameter.

Full generation fills the public layout using only training words, the fixed masks and the page's declared section and Currier group. Compare iid sampling from the layout group; a lexical bigram with probability .6 of drawing from a known predecessor's training successors; a first/last-glyph class analogue with the same mixture; and a self-copy procedure with the global training adjacent identity rate and otherwise independent group draws. Back off from an unseen layout group to section and then the full training inventory. The class chain chooses a class then a token from the available training class in the layout group or globally. Resets follow line edges and masks. These are mechanical word-order controls and do not name any graph statistic in their generation rule.

Use 24 prespecified replicate seeds per mechanism and 39 independent within-line shuffles of each realization for its own null mean. A candidate matches an observed coordinate if it falls in the model's 5th–95th percentile residual envelope. Keep full sample extrema and all coordinates, with no tuning from public evaluation outcomes. Exact fixed-bag uniform and full-layout iid arms are negative checks. Reverse each valid run to verify the undirected-in-sign summaries' invariance to edge reversal; this is an identity check, not evidence of power. No hidden allocation is read and there is no official hidden verdict for this combined diagnostic.

analysis: The 31 public pages in each edition contribute 652 nonempty paragraph lines. The manuscript off-diagonal excess and lower graph degree are each at the .01 two-sided Monte Carlo floor against the line null in all three editions. Self-loop-type two-sided values are .35, .97 and .32 in ZL, IT and RF.
Observed unequal repeated edges number 202, 185 and 148 in ZL, IT and RF. The corresponding increases over the line null per eligible boundary are .013410, .012239 and .014005.

The audit's mean directed out-degree uses distinct ordered arcs divided by every valid type. The paper supplement defines degree with undirected adjacency for its assortativity result. The separately reported loop-excluded undirected sensitivity also gives less degree than the line null in each edition.

With edge opportunities and vertex count fixed, mean directed out-degree is the complement of total edge-occurrence surplus on a fixed scale. The number of distinct repeated pair types counts a different aspect of recurrence. Reversal of each intact word run preserves the reported scalar graph measures by construction.

Conditional lexical rewards overshoot the main repeated-edge residual in ZL and IT, whereas the glyph-class mechanisms generate too little. Direct self-copy raises the self-loop count and leaves the unequal-edge residual subcritical. The RF off-diagonal conditional arm jointly matches all three predeclared residual envelopes; its exact observed bags mean that it tests local ordering only.
The three editions represent alternative readings of the same manuscript. Envelopes from 24 frozen seeds are descriptive and no model was selected against the observed practice statistics.

Scalar spot checks agreed on 164 observed layouts and 820 exact line permutations. A separate combinatorial calculation reproduced the distinct self-loop expectation on 1,098 exhaustively enumerated tiny orbits.

from collections import Counter, defaultdict
from math import sqrt

from vs import ivtff

MASK = -1
ORDERERS = ("conditional_uniform", "conditional_lexical", "conditional_diagonal",
            "conditional_off_diagonal", "conditional_glyph")
GENERATORS = ("layout_iid", "layout_lexical", "layout_glyph", "layout_self_copy")


class LocalModel:
    def __init__(self, training, words):
        self.lexicon = words
        self.indices = {word: i for i, word in enumerate(words)}
        self.glyphs = []
        for word in words:
            parsed = ivtff.segment(word)
            self.glyphs.append((parsed[0], parsed[-1]))
        self.global_bag = []
        self.section_bags = defaultdict(list)
        self.group_bags = defaultdict(list)
        self.known_next = defaultdict(list)
        self.glyph_next = defaultdict(list)
        self.known_counts = defaultdict(Counter)
        self.glyph_counts = defaultdict(Counter)
        self.group_glyph_bags = defaultdict(list)
        self.global_glyph_bags = defaultdict(list)
        for page in training:
            group = page.section, page.language
            for line in page.lines:
                if line.unit != "P" or not line.words:
                    continue
                row = self.encode(line.words)
                valid = [word for word in row if word != MASK]
                self.global_bag.extend(valid)
                self.section_bags[page.section].extend(valid)
                self.group_bags[group].extend(valid)
                for word in valid:
                    self.group_glyph_bags[group, self.glyphs[word]].append(word)
                    self.global_glyph_bags[self.glyphs[word]].append(word)
                for prev, word in zip(row, row[1:]):
                    if prev == MASK or word == MASK:
                        continue
                    a, b = self.glyphs[prev], self.glyphs[word]
                    self.known_next[prev].append(word)
                    self.glyph_next[a].append(b)
                    self.known_counts[prev][word] += 1
                    self.glyph_counts[a][b] += 1
        self.freq = Counter(self.global_bag)
        self.glyph_freq = Counter(self.glyphs[word] for word in self.global_bag)
        self.train_words = len(self.global_bag)
        edge_count = sum(map(len, self.known_next.values()))
        self.identity = sum(row[word] for word, row in self.known_counts.items()) / edge_count
        self.train_edges = edge_count
        self._conditional_bonus = {}

    def encode(self, words):
        return [MASK if ivtff.uncertain(word) else self.indices[word] for word in words]

    def bonus(self, prev, word, mode):
        if prev == MASK or mode == "conditional_uniform":
            return 1.
        if mode == "conditional_diagonal" and prev != word:
            return 1.
        if mode == "conditional_off_diagonal" and prev == word:
            return 1.
        is_class = mode == "conditional_glyph"
        a, b = (self.glyphs[prev], self.glyphs[word]) if is_class else (prev, word)
        key = (is_class, a, b)
        cached = self._conditional_bonus.get(key)
        if cached is not None:
            return cached
        frequencies = self.glyph_freq if is_class else self.freq
        rows = self.glyph_counts if is_class else self.known_counts
        hits = rows.get(a, {}).get(b, 0)
        if not hits:
            return 1.
        q = (frequencies[b] + .5) / (self.train_words + .5 * (len(frequencies) + 1))
        value = sqrt(1 + hits / (4 * q))
        self._conditional_bonus[key] = value
        return value

    def reorder(self, lines, mode, rng):
        result = []
        for source in lines:
            bag = Counter(word for word in source if word != MASK)
            line, prev = [], MASK
            for original_word in source:
                if original_word == MASK:
                    line.append(MASK)
                    prev = MASK
                    continue
                words = sorted(bag)
                weights = [bag[word] * self.bonus(prev, word, mode) for word in words]
                word = rng.choices(words, weights=weights, k=1)[0]
                bag[word] -= 1
                if not bag[word]:
                    del bag[word]
                line.append(word)
                prev = word
            result.append(line)
        return result

    def generate(self, lines, groups, mode, rng):
        result = []
        for shape, group in zip(lines, groups):
            bag = self.group_bags.get(group) or self.section_bags.get(group[0]) or self.global_bag
            line, prev = [], MASK
            for slot in shape:
                if slot == MASK:
                    word = MASK
                elif mode == "layout_lexical" and self.known_next.get(prev) and rng.random() < .6:
                    word = rng.choice(self.known_next[prev])
                elif mode == "layout_glyph" and prev != MASK and rng.random() < .6 and self.glyph_next.get(self.glyphs[prev]):
                    state = rng.choice(self.glyph_next[self.glyphs[prev]])
                    word = rng.choice(self.group_glyph_bags.get((group, state)) or self.global_glyph_bags[state])
                elif mode == "layout_self_copy" and prev != MASK and rng.random() < self.identity:
                    word = prev
                else:
                    word = rng.choice(bag)
                line.append(word)
                prev = word
            result.append(line)
        return result

from collections import Counter, defaultdict
from concurrent.futures import ProcessPoolExecutor
import json
from pathlib import Path
from random import Random
import sys

import numpy as np

from vs import corpus, ivtff

from exact_loops import expected_self_loop_types
from mechanisms import GENERATORS, ORDERERS, LocalModel, MASK
from network_metrics import NetworkLayout, network_metrics

WORK = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
SAMPLES = 24
GENERATED_NULL_DRAWS = 39
MEASURES = (
    "loop_types_share", "repeated_edge_share", "directed_out_degree",
    "repeated_unequal_share", "unequal_out_degree", "undirected_degree",
)
PRIMARY = MEASURES[:3]


def measures(raw):
    vertices = raw["vertex_types"]
    edges = raw["eligible_boundaries"]
    return np.array([raw["self_loop_types"] / vertices, raw["repeated_all_edges"] / edges,
                     raw["mean_out_degree_including_loops"], raw["repeated_unequal_edges"] / edges,
                     raw["mean_out_degree"], raw["mean_undirected_degree"]])


def vectors(layout, n, rng):
    return np.stack([measures(layout.shuffle_counts(rng)) for _ in range(n)])


def summary(obs, null):
    upper = (1 + (null >= obs).sum(axis=0)) / (len(null) + 1)
    lower = (1 + (null <= obs).sum(axis=0)) / (len(null) + 1)
    center = null.mean(axis=0)
    return {
        field: {"observed": float(obs[i]), "mean": float(center[i]),
                "residual": float(obs[i] - center[i]), "upper_p": float(upper[i]),
                "lower_p": float(lower[i]), "two_sided_p": float(min(1, 2 * min(upper[i], lower[i])))}
        for i, field in enumerate(MEASURES)
    }


def reverse_runs(lines):
    reversed_lines = []
    for line in lines:
        new, run = [], []
        for word in line:
            if word == MASK:
                new.extend(reversed(run))
                new.append(MASK)
                run.clear()
            else:
                run.append(word)
        new.extend(reversed(run))
        reversed_lines.append(new)
    return reversed_lines


def fixed_page_permutations(lines, pages, rng, n):
    destinations = defaultdict(list)
    for row, (line, page) in enumerate(zip(lines, pages)):
        destinations[page].extend((row, i) for i, word in enumerate(line) if word != MASK)
    original = [[lines[row][col] for row, col in cells] for cells in destinations.values()]
    out = []
    for _ in range(n):
        reconstructed = [line.copy() for line in lines]
        for cells, words in zip(destinations.values(), original):
            for (row, col), word in zip(cells, rng.permutation(words)):
                reconstructed[row][col] = int(word)
        out.append(measures(network_metrics(reconstructed)))
    return np.stack(out)


def load_data(code):
    train, practice = corpus.split_pages("practice", code)
    vocab = sorted({word for page in (*train, *practice) for ln in page.lines
                    if ln.unit == "P" for word in ln.words if not ivtff.uncertain(word)})
    model = LocalModel(train, vocab)
    blocks = [(p.id, (p.section, p.language), model.encode(ln.words))
              for p in practice for ln in p.lines if ln.unit == "P" and ln.words]
    pages, groups, lines = tuple(zip(*blocks))
    return model, pages, groups, list(lines)


def all_runs(code, n):
    model, page_ids, groups, lines = load_data(code)
    layout = NetworkLayout(lines)
    raw = layout.observed()
    assert raw == network_metrics(reverse_runs(lines)), "reversing a run changes a direction-invariant statistic"
    observed = measures(raw)
    rng = np.random.default_rng(98721)
    line_ref = vectors(layout, 199, rng)
    page_ref = fixed_page_permutations(lines, page_ids, rng, 99)
    empirical_loop = line_ref[:, 0] * raw["vertex_types"]
    exact_loop = expected_self_loop_types(lines)
    assert abs(empirical_loop.mean() - exact_loop) <= 5 * empirical_loop.std(ddof=1) / np.sqrt(len(empirical_loop))

    line_test = summary(observed, line_ref)
    observed_diff = np.array([line_test[x]["residual"] for x in MEASURES])
    print(code, "observed", raw, "residual", list(observed_diff), flush=True)
    rows = {}
    for mode in ORDERERS + GENERATORS:
        replicates = []
        for j in range(n):
            seed = 303001 + 101 * j
            choice = Random(seed)
            shuffled = (model.reorder(lines, mode, choice) if mode in ORDERERS
                        else model.generate(lines, groups, mode, choice))
            if mode in ORDERERS:
                assert all(Counter(a) == Counter(b) for a, b in zip(lines, shuffled))
            assert all(len(a) == len(b) and all((x == MASK) == (y == MASK) for x, y in zip(a, b))
                       for a, b in zip(lines, shuffled))
            fake_layout = NetworkLayout(shuffled)
            fake_raw = fake_layout.observed()
            empirical = vectors(fake_layout, GENERATED_NULL_DRAWS, np.random.default_rng(seed + 10))
            observed_value = measures(fake_raw)
            null_mean = empirical.mean(axis=0)
            replicates.append({"seed": seed, "support": fake_raw,
                               "observed": observed_value.tolist(), "null_mean": null_mean.tolist(),
                               "residual": (observed_value - null_mean).tolist()})
        values = np.array([row["residual"] for row in replicates])
        lo, hi = np.quantile(values, [.05, .95], axis=0)
        lo_full, hi_full = values.min(axis=0), values.max(axis=0)
        coords = {
            key: {"min": float(lo_full[i]), "max": float(hi_full[i]),
                  "median": float(np.median(values[:, i])),
                  "central_90": [float(lo[i]), float(hi[i])],
                  "match_90": bool(lo[i] <= observed_diff[i] <= hi[i]),
                  "match_range": bool(lo_full[i] <= observed_diff[i] <= hi_full[i])}
            for i, key in enumerate(MEASURES)
        }
        primary = all(coords[metric]["match_90"] for metric in PRIMARY)
        rows[mode] = {"matches_primary": primary, "coordinates": coords, "replicates": replicates}
        print(code, mode, {key: coords[key]["match_90"] for key in PRIMARY}, flush=True)
    return code, {"model_training": {"words": model.train_words, "edges": model.train_edges,
                                     "identity_rate": model.identity, "word_types": len(model.freq),
                                     "glyph_classes": len(model.glyph_freq)},
                  "pages": len(set(page_ids)), "paragraph_lines": len(lines), "raw": raw,
                  "line_null_expected_loops_exact": exact_loop,
                  "line_null_loop_monte_carlo_standard_error": float(empirical_loop.std(ddof=1) / np.sqrt(len(empirical_loop))),
                  "line_null": line_test, "page_null": summary(observed, page_ref), "arms": rows}


def main():
    smoke = "--smoke" in sys.argv
    with ProcessPoolExecutor(max_workers=3) as pool:
        futures = [pool.submit(all_runs, code, 2 if smoke else SAMPLES)
                   for code in corpus.EVA_TRANSLITERATIONS]
        rows = dict(task.result() for task in futures)
    report = {"measure_order": MEASURES, "primary": PRIMARY, "replicates": 2 if smoke else SAMPLES,
              "generated_null_draws": GENERATED_NULL_DRAWS, "editions": rows}
    (WORK / ("smoke.json" if smoke else "results.json")).write_text(
        json.dumps(report, separators=(",", ":")) + "\n"
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Local word network counts and line-multiset permutations."""

from collections import defaultdict

import numpy as np


class NetworkLayout:
    """Freeze line boundaries, negative-ID barrier positions, and token inventories."""

    def __init__(self, lines):
        rows = [np.asarray(line, dtype=np.int64) for line in lines]
        self._offsets = np.cumsum([0] + [len(row) for row in rows], dtype=np.intp)
        self._tokens = np.concatenate(rows) if rows else np.empty(0, dtype=np.int64)
        valid = self._tokens >= 0
        vertices, codes = np.unique(self._tokens[valid], return_inverse=True)
        self._vertex_count = len(vertices)
        self._codes = self._tokens.copy()
        self._codes[valid] = codes

        adjacent = valid[:-1] & valid[1:]
        ends = self._offsets[1:] - 1
        adjacent[ends[(ends >= 0) & (ends < len(adjacent))]] = False
        self._edge_starts = np.flatnonzero(adjacent)

        by_length = defaultdict(list)
        for offset, row in zip(self._offsets, rows):
            positions = offset + np.flatnonzero(row >= 0)
            if len(positions) > 1:
                by_length[len(positions)].append(positions)
        self._shuffle_groups = [np.stack(group) for group in by_length.values()]

    def _counts(self, codes):
        left = codes[self._edge_starts]
        right = codes[self._edge_starts + 1]
        # Compact vertex IDs make each edge a base-V integer. Self edges have equal digits.
        edges, counts = np.unique(left * self._vertex_count + right, return_counts=True)
        self_loops = edges % (self._vertex_count + 1) == 0
        repeated = counts >= 2
        unequal = int(np.count_nonzero(~self_loops))
        undirected = 0
        if unequal:
            source, target = np.divmod(edges[~self_loops], self._vertex_count)
            low, high = np.minimum(source, target), np.maximum(source, target)
            undirected = len(np.unique(low * self._vertex_count + high))
        return {
            "self_loop_types": int(np.count_nonzero(self_loops)),
            "repeated_self_loop_types": int(np.count_nonzero(self_loops & repeated)),
            "repeated_unequal_edges": int(np.count_nonzero(~self_loops & repeated)),
            "repeated_all_edges": int(np.count_nonzero(repeated)),
            "distinct_unequal_edges": unequal,
            "mean_out_degree": unequal / self._vertex_count if self._vertex_count else 0.0,
            "mean_out_degree_including_loops": (
                len(edges) / self._vertex_count if self._vertex_count else 0.0
            ),
            "mean_undirected_degree": 2 * undirected / self._vertex_count if self._vertex_count else 0.0,
            "eligible_boundaries": len(self._edge_starts),
            "vertex_types": self._vertex_count,
        }

    def _shuffle(self, tokens, rng):
        result = tokens.copy()
        for positions in self._shuffle_groups:
            result[positions] = rng.permuted(tokens[positions], axis=1)
        return result

    def observed(self):
        """Calculate counts for the original within-line order."""
        return self._counts(self._codes)

    def shuffle_counts(self, rng):
        """Calculate counts for a fresh independent line permutation."""
        return self._counts(self._shuffle(self._codes, rng))

    def shuffled(self, rng):
        """Return rows with their original IDs and fixed negative barriers."""
        tokens = self._shuffle(self._tokens, rng)
        return [tokens[a:b].tolist() for a, b in zip(self._offsets, self._offsets[1:])]


def network_metrics(lines):
    """Count directed adjacency features, treating line ends and negatives as barriers."""
    return NetworkLayout(lines).observed()


def line_shuffle(lines, rng):
    """Uniformly permute all unmasked words within each original line."""
    return NetworkLayout(lines).shuffled(rng)

verify_network.py.text:
"""Independently verify the network metrics and line-permutation invariants."""

from collections import Counter
from random import Random

import numpy as np

from network_metrics import NetworkLayout, line_shuffle, network_metrics


def scalar_metrics(lines):
    vertices = {word for line in lines for word in line if word >= 0}
    edge_counts = Counter(
        (left, right)
        for line in lines
        for left, right in zip(line, line[1:])
        if left >= 0 and right >= 0
    )
    unequal_edges = [count for (left, right), count in edge_counts.items() if left != right]
    undirected_edges = {tuple(sorted(edge)) for edge in edge_counts if edge[0] != edge[1]}
    return {
        "self_loop_types": sum(left == right for left, right in edge_counts),
        "repeated_self_loop_types": sum(
            left == right and count >= 2 for (left, right), count in edge_counts.items()
        ),
        "repeated_unequal_edges": sum(count >= 2 for count in unequal_edges),
        "repeated_all_edges": sum(count >= 2 for count in edge_counts.values()),
        "distinct_unequal_edges": len(unequal_edges),
        "mean_out_degree": len(unequal_edges) / len(vertices) if vertices else 0.0,
        "mean_out_degree_including_loops": len(edge_counts) / len(vertices) if vertices else 0.0,
        "mean_undirected_degree": 2 * len(undirected_edges) / len(vertices) if vertices else 0.0,
        "eligible_boundaries": sum(edge_counts.values()),
        "vertex_types": len(vertices),
    }


def verify():
    hand_fixture = [[2, 2, 3, 2, 3, -4, 3, 3], [], [3], [-5], [2], [91]]
    assert network_metrics(hand_fixture) == {
        "self_loop_types": 2,
        "repeated_self_loop_types": 0,
        "repeated_unequal_edges": 1,
        "repeated_all_edges": 1,
        "distinct_unequal_edges": 2,
        "mean_out_degree": 2 / 3,
        "mean_out_degree_including_loops": 4 / 3,
        "mean_undirected_degree": 2 / 3,
        "eligible_boundaries": 5,
        "vertex_types": 3,
    }
    rng = Random(153520)
    pool = [-17, -4, -1, 0, 1, 5, 9, 2**62]
    fixtures = [[], [[]], [[-3, -2]], hand_fixture]
    fixtures.extend(
        [[rng.choice(pool) for _ in range(rng.randrange(16))]
         for _ in range(rng.randrange(38))]
        for _ in range(160)
    )
    for i, lines in enumerate(fixtures):
        layout = NetworkLayout(lines)
        assert layout.observed() == scalar_metrics(lines)
        for seed in range(5):
            shuffled = line_shuffle(lines, np.random.default_rng(seed + i * 5))
            assert len(shuffled) == len(lines)
            for original, permuted in zip(lines, shuffled):
                assert Counter(permuted) == Counter(original)
                assert all(a == b for a, b in zip(original, permuted) if a < 0)
            actual = layout.shuffle_counts(np.random.default_rng(seed + i * 5))
            assert actual == scalar_metrics(shuffled)

    renamed = [[word * 2 + 101 if word >= 0 else word for word in line] for line in hand_fixture]
    assert network_metrics(renamed) == network_metrics(hand_fixture)
    print(f"{len(fixtures)} observed layouts and {5 * len(fixtures)} permutations agree with the scalar reference.")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    verify()
